summary: The tutorial covers various view options in LibreOffice Impress for creating and editing presentations. It starts with the default Normal view, which can be accessed via the Normal tab or the View menu. Users can switch to Outline view to organize slides hierarchically, using bullet points and icons. Slide Sorter view allows reordering slides by dragging them. Notes view enables adding notes for each slide, accessible through the Notes tab. The tutorial also explains how to customize slide layouts using the Layout section, selecting from predefined designs or customizing existing ones. Master pages can be used to set uniform design elements like backgrounds and titles across all slides. The session concludes with instructions on creating a new presentation with a dark blue background and light blue title areas, encouraging viewers to practice these skills.
